statements.t: The energy resources needed to serve this expected load while maintaining safe and reliable service for all customers have increased the Company’s forecasted capital expenditures for 2027 through 2030 to $15.9 billion.
The Company announced 2027 earnings guidance of $3.63 to $3.73 per share.

“We delivered another solid quarter of operating performance and our full-year earnings expectation has been narrowed to within the top half of the original 2026 ongoing EPS guidance range,” said Lisa Barton, Alliant Energy President and CEO.
An archive of the webcast will be available on the Company’s website at www.alliantenergy.com/investors for 12 months.
